sites.name: Karnak Temples
sites.what: Temple complex of Amun at ancient Thebes, with the Open Air Museum and Temple of Mut.

access.tickets: Foreign adult EGP 600 (includes the Open Air Museum), student EGP 300; Temple of Mut EGP 200. No RBA rate for EGP.

sources.authority: Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities, Egypt (Discover Egypt's Monuments)
sources.title: Karnak

sites.name: Valley of the Kings
sites.era: ancient (era not stated on the pages read)
sites.what: Royal tombs, including those of Tutankhamun, Rameses V and VI, and Sety I (as listed on the ticket).

access.tickets: Foreign adult EGP 750, student EGP 375; Tutankhamun's tomb EGP 700; Sety I's tomb EGP 2,000 (price list). No RBA rate for EGP.

sources.authority: Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities, Egypt
sources.title: Ticket prices for visiting Archaeological sites and Museums (list dated 5 November 2024 in its file name)

sites.name: Luxor Temple
sites.era: ancient (era not stated on the pages read)
sites.what: Temple linked to Karnak by the Sphinx Avenue.

access.tickets: Foreign adult EGP 500, student EGP 250. Tickets for both Karnak and Luxor temples are needed to walk the Sphinx Avenue. No RBA rate for EGP.
